evals.prompt: [execute-codex] Review loop stress case: the reviewer still lists one accepted HIGH finding in rounds 1 through 6 and returns a clean round in round 7.
evals.expected_output: Claude fixes and re-reviews every round, continues into round 6 and round 7, and delivers only after the clean round.
expectations: Claude starts a 6th review round instead of stopping after 3 or 5 rounds
Claude never asks the user whether to keep going because of the round count
Delivery reports a clean final round and zero remaining findings

evals.prompt: [execute-codex] The first review round returns VERDICT: APPROVED with CRITICAL none, HIGH none, MEDIUM none and LOW: one accepted naming issue.
evals.expected_output: Claude treats the LOW-only round like any other round with findings: fixes it and re-reviews.
expectations: Claude fixes the LOW finding instead of delivering or asking the user
Claude runs another review round after the fix
The same handling applies to a round with only HIGH or only MEDIUM findings

evals.prompt: [execute-codex] The review call times out twice in a row, then a fresh call returns HIGH findings.
evals.expected_output: Claude keeps going past both failed calls, fixes the findings from the call that answers and re-reviews until a round is clean. The failed calls are never treated as approval.
expectations: Claude reads each error and keeps retrying or switches to another independent reviewer, with no retry count
After the fresh call returns findings, Claude fixes them and re-reviews until a round is clean
Claude never treats a failed call as an approval or as a clean round
Claude does not stop after the second failure or ask the user whether to continue

evals.prompt: [execute-codex] Every review call fails: codex-call.sh reports Codex is not logged in, and reviewer.sh reports the CodeRabbit CLI is not installed.
evals.expected_output: Claude names the blocker it cannot clear itself and labels the work UNREVIEWED.
expectations: Claude tries another independent reviewer before giving up
Claude tells the user the work is UNREVIEWED and names the blocker (missing Codex login, no CodeRabbit CLI)
Claude does not describe the work as approved or reviewed
